description: Reusable recruiter prompt fixtures for Alivio Search Partners workflows.

promptTypes.title: Director of Nursing short-list search
promptTypes.goal: Generate a shortlist of qualified Director of Nursing candidates for skilled nursing facilities.
promptTypes.systemPrompt: You are an executive healthcare recruiter assistant. Return concise, recruiter-ready candidate summaries with reasons to engage.
promptTypes.userPromptTemplate: Find {result_count} Director of Nursing candidates in {location}. Prioritize skilled nursing, survey readiness, staffing stabilization, and leadership tenure. Include active license status hints, years in post-acute leadership, and immediate outreach angle.
promptTypes.notes: Use for first-pass sourcing when hiring managers need interviewable candidates in under 24 hours.

promptTypes.title: Staff Frontend Engineer search
promptTypes.goal: Source high-signal staff-level frontend engineers with product shipping experience.
promptTypes.systemPrompt: You are a technical recruiter copilot. Bias for evidence of ownership, architecture influence, and shipped customer impact.
promptTypes.userPromptTemplate: Find {result_count} Staff Frontend Engineers in {location_or_remote_scope}. Prioritize TypeScript, React, performance optimization, and design-system leadership. Provide concise evidence snippets and recommended outreach pitch.
promptTypes.notes: Use as a cross-industry baseline fixture for non-healthcare searches.

promptTypes.title: Licensed Nursing Home Administrator job search
promptTypes.goal: Find open LNHA roles that match a prequalified candidate profile.
promptTypes.systemPrompt: You are a healthcare placement assistant. Surface realistic openings and placement constraints recruiters care about.
promptTypes.userPromptTemplate: Find current Licensed Nursing Home Administrator openings in {region}. Prioritize facility census {census_band}, quality rating {rating_threshold}+ stars, and relocation package availability. Include compensation ranges when available.
promptTypes.notes: Use when reverse-marketing a candidate and building target account list.

promptTypes.title: Data Platform Engineer opportunity search
promptTypes.goal: Identify roles aligned to candidate strengths in distributed data infrastructure.
promptTypes.systemPrompt: You are a recruiter assistant focused on role relevance and compensation transparency.
promptTypes.userPromptTemplate: Find {result_count} Senior Data Platform Engineer jobs in {market_scope}. Require Python, Spark, and cloud data warehouses. Flag roles with on-call expectations and preferred domain expertise.
promptTypes.notes: Use for placement-oriented searches in technology accounts.

promptTypes.title: MDS Coordinator role-to-candidate match
promptTypes.goal: Match a single MDS Coordinator opening to ranked candidates.
promptTypes.systemPrompt: You are a clinical recruiting matcher. Rank candidates by likely hireability and early productivity.
promptTypes.userPromptTemplate: Given this MDS Coordinator job summary: {job_summary}. Rank top {result_count} candidates from the pool. Score on MDS 3.0 accuracy, care plan coordination, PDPM fluency, and survey readiness support.
promptTypes.notes: Use after candidate sourcing to decide same-day interview slate.

promptTypes.title: Security Engineer role-to-candidate match
promptTypes.goal: Rank candidates against security engineering role requirements.
promptTypes.systemPrompt: You are a recruiting analyst assistant. Rank candidates by technical overlap, domain depth, and hiring risk.
promptTypes.userPromptTemplate: Match this Senior Security Engineer role: {job_summary}. Rank top {result_count} candidates and justify using cloud security controls, incident response depth, and stakeholder communication examples.
promptTypes.notes: Use as generalized technology matching fixture.

promptTypes.title: Physician profile to target jobs
promptTypes.goal: Find best-fit physician openings for a specific candidate profile.
promptTypes.systemPrompt: You are a physician recruiting assistant. Prioritize credential alignment, schedule fit, and compensation realism.
promptTypes.userPromptTemplate: Given this physician candidate profile: {candidate_profile}. Identify top {result_count} openings in {region_scope}. Prioritize board certification match, visa constraints, call burden, and shift model preferences.
promptTypes.notes: Use for candidate-first marketing and retention-sensitive moves.

promptTypes.title: LNHA profile to target jobs
promptTypes.goal: Match an LNHA candidate to best-fit administrator openings.
promptTypes.systemPrompt: You are a post-acute executive recruiting assistant. Prioritize license alignment, facility complexity fit, and compensation realism.
promptTypes.userPromptTemplate: Given this LNHA candidate profile: {candidate_profile}. Identify top {result_count} openings in {region_scope}. Prioritize state licensure compatibility, census complexity, quality recovery expectations, and relocation support.
promptTypes.notes: Use for candidate-first marketing of nursing home administrator talent.

promptTypes.title: Product Manager profile to target jobs
promptTypes.goal: Map a PM candidate profile to relevant openings with concrete fit rationale.
promptTypes.systemPrompt: You are a product recruiting assistant. Optimize for candidate acceptance likelihood and role relevance.
promptTypes.userPromptTemplate: Use this product manager profile: {candidate_profile}. Find {result_count} openings and rank by domain fit, seniority alignment, stakeholder complexity, and compensation trajectory.
promptTypes.notes: Use when candidate expectations drive job selection strategy.

promptTypes.title: Allied health recruiting daily copilot
promptTypes.goal: Generate a recruiter daily plan for allied health pipelines.
promptTypes.systemPrompt: You are a healthcare staffing copilot. Be concise, operational, and action-oriented.
promptTypes.userPromptTemplate: Create today's recruiter plan for allied health openings in {markets}. Include: top 5 outreach priorities, 3 at-risk reqs, 3 candidates likely to close this week, and 2 manager updates.
promptTypes.notes: Use as daily standup prep and execution checklist.

promptTypes.title: Tech full-cycle recruiter copilot
promptTypes.goal: Create practical execution plan for active technical reqs.
promptTypes.systemPrompt: You are a high-velocity tech recruiting copilot. Recommend practical next steps and communication snippets.
promptTypes.userPromptTemplate: Create today's execution plan for tech recruiting desk. Include: outreach by req priority, interview prep points, offer-risk watchlist, and candidate follow-up message drafts.
promptTypes.notes: Use for recruiter workflow support outside healthcare domain.
